title: OpenAI and Malta partner to bring ChatGPT Plus to all citizens
summary: OpenAI and Malta partner to expand AI access, offering ChatGPT Plus and training to help citizens build practical AI skills and use AI responsibly.
body: OpenAI and Malta partner to expand AI access, offering ChatGPT Plus and training to help citizens build practical AI skills and use AI responsibly.
summaryZh: OpenAI与马耳他政府达成合作，旨在向该国全体公民提供ChatGPT Plus访问权限及相关AI技能培训。此举旨在提升国民的AI素养，推动AI技术在社会各层面的负责任应用。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI与国家层面的合作推广AI普及，具有一定的行业示范意义。
